BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your questions.
Considered.

A practical starting point for your high-mast & area lighting enquiry.

Where is high-mast lighting typically used?

High-mast systems are used where a large area needs coverage from a limited number of mounting locations, such as logistics yards and extensive car parks. The choice between high masts and smaller poles depends on the design, site constraints and maintenance approach.

How are mounting height and light positions selected?

These should be established through the lighting design, taking account of the task, dimensions of the site, obstructions and surrounding properties. Installation follows the agreed layout and equipment specification.

What should be considered for future maintenance?

Allow for safe access to luminaires and controls, equipment clearances, isolation arrangements and the intended lifting or lowering method. These requirements are easier to resolve during design than after the installation is complete.
